test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(68, 46, 22) (242, 160, 82)
solution:
**Logic: First number - second number = Third number **

(68, 46, 22) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] 68 - 46 = 22

(242, 160, 82) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] 242 - 160 = 82

Only option 1 holds the logic

**(108, 75, 33) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] 108 - 75 = 33**

Hence, **Option 1)** is the correct answer.
